integrity: All-parameter proof is an explicit order classification and elementary link-collapse argument; independent finite order and collapse checks were completed for one, two, and three squares, and do not substitute for the general proof.
limitations: The theorem requires at least two unfilled four-cycles with exactly one common vertex. It does not cover arbitrary cacti, one-square collapse, other cycle lengths, or symmetry actions.
title: A six-cycle join core for strong Morse matching complexes of square bouquets
